summary: The proof correctly applies accepted fact 6b09aae189415c70 to the nonzero full reservoir measure. Its base affine dimension is at most n, its continuous residual rank is at most d by the admissible zero affine map, and these bounds give M_off(C) >= Q/(d+1). Nonnegativity of every other summand gives the same lower bound for A(C), and the strict Q/100 hypothesis then excludes every positive integer d <= 99.
